IGUI_PZOptPreloader_AotSetupInfo:
PZ Optimization Preloader: Automatic AOT setup
You can continue playing normally. No restart is needed now.
At future normal starts, the JVM cache will be recorded
and then enabled automatically. Quit the game normally
after playing so the recording can finish.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_missing: The required PZ_Optimization files were not found.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_invalid: The available PZ_Optimization files are incomplete or unreadable.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_Intro: Download PZ_Optimization from GitHub and extract it into the folder below. Optimization is inactive until the files are installed and the game is fully restarted.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_Manual: Choose the matching pzopt-...-classes.zip release asset, not Source code. Extract its contents directly into the target folder: pzopt/build-info.properties must be inside it. Do not run install.ps1 or install.sh. Then fully restart the game.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_checking: Looking for a release matching your game revision...
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_complete: Installation complete. Fully quit and restart Project Zomboid to load the files.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_failed: Installation failed. Your previous installation was preserved. Details:
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_disabled: Preloader disabled. The game can continue without PZ Optimization.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_noRelease: No compatible GitHub release was found for this game revision. No files were installed.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_checksum: The download could not be verified. No files were installed.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_rateLimit: GitHub is limiting requests. Try again later or install manually.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_busy: Another installation is already running. Wait for it to finish.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_update: A newer PZ_Optimization release is available.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_UpdateIntro: Your installed version remains active. The update is prepared in the folder below and activated at the next full game start, after all processes using the old installation have closed.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_PreviousAvaila: A previously loaded version is available: %1
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_retained: The previous version remains active. This incompatible release will not be offered again; newer releases will still be checked.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_rollback: The retained version is selected for the next full game start. Fully quit and restart Project Zomboid.
IGUI_PZOptPreloader_Setup_incompatible: These PZ_Optimization files cannot be used with this game version.
IGUI_PZPeek_VisibilityTooltip: Visibility of ordinary faded trees: 0%% invisible, 100%% opaque. Applies indoors and outdoors. Jumbo tree crowns follow Peek a View. Default: 30%%.
IGUI_PZPeek_VisibilityHelp: Default: 30%%. 0%% = invisible, 100%% = opaque. Ordinary trees only.
